title: Perfect! On point!
body:
If you are wondering how to boost up your productivity and getting things done on time, especially for iOS users, look no more! 
After countless apps which are overly complicated I have found out that the simpler - the better!
Everything in one place, connected to your calendars, thank you Apple for listening to your users!

title: Quickly responds across devices
body: I can close a macOS notification from Reminders from my phone very quickly, which is pretty cool. And repeating reminders are a good way to track pill intake, but very occasionally unfortunately buggy, where I can mark a future reminder as done as well because in some edge cases the notification pops up.
